exposure: AoP during Valsalva maneuver (before and after visual feedback)
outcome: Duration of labor stages (first, second, active second)
cohort: 222 low-risk nulliparous women with singleton pregnancy at term
finding: Wider AoP at rest and under Valsalva is associated with vaginal delivery, shorter interval to delivery, and shorter labor duration in nulliparous women at term.
mod_finding: Wider AoP was associated with vaginal delivery.
